title: Fabulous private tour of Casa Batlló and Park Güell
text: Our tour was phenomenal. A slight change, as one of our tours was cancelled. So instead, the company was so accommodating and we had a private tour of Casa Batlló and Park Güell. Our guide Anna was wonderful. She was so kind and knowledgeable. We loved seeing these amazing sites and learning all the history.  Highly recommend this tour!
author: Laura I

title: Swift and Excellent Tour at Golden Hour
text: Efficient and informational private tour detailing the history of Sagrada Familia and Park Guell. Skip the line access was most beneficial and tour shows why these two landmarks are the most special in Barcelona.
author: ANTampa68
